problems.text: Module `.` (sbt root, 0 files) is claimed by no service or library; assemble defaults it to a library.
pipelines_shared is registered into both Flyte projects (feature-store, demand-forecast) so both services claim it.
payments-webhook writes public.reservations, a table owned by the reservations service (documented shortcut in payments_webhook/app/main.py).

Scala ZLayer implementations are anonymous classes inside vals and were not scanned; relations attach to the trait methods (ReceiptStore#put, StripeCharger#confirm, StripeGateway#createIntent, SharedCache#occupancyPercent, QuoteCache, Geocoder, DeadLetters#park) and to the endpoint/consumer/relay objects.

Tapir routes of the Scala services are not listed in summary.md; request targets use QuoteEndpoint/SettleEndpoint routes/1 as the handler node. Public reservations routes (POST /v1/reservations, GET /v1/reservations/{id}, POST /v1/reservations/{id}/cancel) have no in-repo caller.

Airflow @task functions nested in each @dag function were not scanned as methods; DAG relations attach to the DAG function. SUBTRACT_REFUNDS (pg_revenue_correction.py) is a module constant run by daily_revenue_rollup and is folded into its relations.
gRPC service definition (proto/occupancy.proto) is not a scanned language; the stream is matched by the proto service/method name and the code on both ends.
S3 key prefixes and Redis key patterns are modeled as table nodes (receipts/, exports/invoices/, exports/audit/, occupancy:{zone}, bays:{zone}, quote:{key}); they are not SQL tables.

SQS dead-letter queue violations-dead.fifo is fed by the queue's RedrivePolicy (infrastructure); no service code publishes to it, so there is no on_failure relation, and no consumer of it exists in the repo.
Kafka topic reservation-events.dlq has no consumer in the repo; operators replay by hand (DeadLetters.scala comment).
Notifier dispatch of SMS/e-mail runs inside handle/3 via common_py clients; modeled from svc:notifier with via. Compose gives REDIS_URL via RESERVATIONS_REDIS_URL.
Hosts for ACCOUNTS_API_URL, FINES_API_URL, SENSORCLOUD_WS_URL, Pub/Sub push endpoint are per deployment; no values read.
Platform boxes (Airflow, Flyte, Kafka brokers, GCP Pub/Sub, SQS, Kubernetes) are not nodes. No hand-launched (manual) jobs are documented, so no adhoc service.

sensor_gateway/app/main.py:22 is the outbox queue main fills and passes to OccupancyUplink.run, which main itself calls: that call already joins producer and consumer, so it is no in-process queue hand-off
module mod:pipelines_shared is deployed by svc:demand-forecast and svc:feature-store: its code sits under svc:demand-forecast; svc:feature-store show(s) a twin
